PROPERTY_HIGHLIGHTS_HTML:
• 4 BR / 3.5 BA luxury home in the sought-after Rea Farms community
  • Open-concept main floor with 10-foot ceilings and wide-plank hardwoods
  • Gourmet kitchen — quartz counters, 48" range, oversized island with seating
  • Primary suite with spa bath, dual vanities, soaking tub & frameless shower
  • Screened rear porch overlooking private, fenced backyard
  • 3-car garage with epoxy floors and EV charging outlet
  • Walkable to Harris Teeter, Stonecrest Town Center & top-rated Rea Farms STEAM Academy

EQUITY_NARRATIVE: Since your purchase in April 2021, the southeast Charlotte luxury market has experienced exceptional growth fueled by strong migration, limited inventory, and demand for newer construction in walkable mixed-use communities. Your home's combination of size, finish level, and location within Rea Farms positions it among the most sought-after offerings in the 28270 zip code. At a recommended list price near $895,000, you would capture meaningful equity appreciation while remaining competitive with the current active market.
